    Costco warehouses are closed on Easter Sunday. This is part of their policy to close for seven major holidays, allowing employees to spend the day with their families. All U.S. locations will be closed on April 5, 2026, and normal operations will resume on Monday, April 6, 2026. 
    • Easter Sunday (April 5, 2026): All locations closed.
    • Gas Stations: Costco gas stations are also closed on Easter.
    • Other Closures: Costco is also closed on New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas. 
    While Costco is closed, other retailers like Walmart, Kroger, and CVS may be open for last-minute needs.
